title: 第15章 又一魔道中人
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
姜暮烟往袖子里面一摸，忽然顿住了。

    “师姐？”

    和铃歪了歪脑袋，看向她，“发生什么事了吗？”

    姜暮烟神色凝重地嗯了一声，道：“我的储物袋和雷火貂不见了。”

    和铃一惊，环视着四周，这里是龙衔宝楼，谁这么大的胆子敢偷大师姐的储物袋和雷火貂？

    好在姜暮烟身上还有一枚储物戒，她拿出灵石结了账，拉着和铃走出龙衔宝楼。

    “阿铃，我先送你去与二师弟、三师弟会合，等你到了灵膳楼，我方才能放心去寻回我的储物袋。”

    和铃原本是金丹境，比自家三师兄第五齐修为还高，根本无需担心安危问题。

    但明瑟真君封了她的修为，她现在也就比凡人强上一点。

    姜暮烟自然处处谨慎。

    和铃觉得自己身上有两个系统傍身，死肯定是死不了的，但她不能把系统的事情说给姜暮烟听，在姜暮烟看来，自家小师妹就是一个手无缚鸡之力之人。

    她必须把和铃安排妥当了，才能去办自己的事情。

    和铃不给她添乱，老老实实听从姜暮烟的安排。

    到了灵膳楼，姜暮烟把事情经过简单说了一下。

    张流川立马起身道：“大师姐，我跟你一块去。”

    “南华城这么大，时间又过去了有一阵子了，你一个人怎么找贼人？”

    “还是我陪你一起吧，两个人力量肯定要大一些。”

    姜暮烟犹豫片刻，第五齐说道：“和铃师妹我会照顾的，大师姐让二师兄陪你一起吧，他擅长追踪之术。”

    “也好。那就小齐你在这儿陪阿铃，我和流川先出去找一圈，要是实在找不到就算了。”

    偌大的雅间内，只剩下了和铃跟第五齐。

    第五齐看向她，“菜已经上了大半了，你先吃吧。”

    他们几人都辟谷，吃不吃饭无所谓，但和铃每天都是要吃饭的。

    她拿起筷子，夹了就近的一口菜，满足地眯了眯眼睛，忽然想起来一件事。

    和铃从袖子里面摸出来一块玉佩，递给第五齐，“小齐师兄，这是给你的。”

    原身以前拿过第五齐一块玉佩，她既然用了这个身份，自然也该继承其因果。

    更何况，混元峰的人对她很好，她是真心把大家当师兄师姐的。

    第五齐接过玉佩，淡淡问道：“你怎么忽然送我礼物了？”
content_en:
Jiang Muyan touched inside her sleeve and suddenly paused.

"Sister?"

He Ling tilted his head and looked at her, "What happened?"

Jiang Muyan hummed solemnly and said, "My storage bag and Thunder Fire Ferret are missing."

He Ling was startled and looked around. This is the Dragon Title Pavilion. Who is so bold and dares to steal Senior Sister's storage bag and Thunder Fire Ferret?

Fortunately, Jiang Muyan still had a storage ring on her body. She took out the spirit stone to pay the bill, and pulled He Ling out of the Longzianbao Tower.

"A-Ling, I will send you to meet the second and third junior brothers first. When you arrive at the Lingshan Building, we can safely retrieve my storage bag."

He Ling was originally in the Golden Core realm, and his cultivation level was higher than that of his third senior brother Qi Qi, so there was no need to worry about safety issues.

But True Lord Mingse sealed her cultivation, and now she is just a little better than a mortal.

Jiang Muyan is naturally cautious in everything.

He Ling felt that there were two systems in her body, and she would definitely not be able to die, but she could not tell Jiang Muyan about the system. In Jiang Muyan's view, her junior sister was a helpless person.

She must make arrangements with Ling before she can do her own things.

He Ling did not cause any trouble for her and obeyed Jiang Muyan's arrangements honestly.

When they arrived at Lingshan Tower, Jiang Muyan briefly explained what happened.

Zhang Liuchuan stood up immediately and said, "Sister, I will go with you."

"Nanhua City is so big, and time has passed for a while. How can you find the thief alone?"

"It's better for me to accompany you. The two of us are definitely stronger."

Jiang Muyan hesitated for a moment, then Fifth Qi said: "I will take care of Junior Sister Heling. Senior Sister, please ask Second Senior Brother to accompany you. He is good at tracking."

"That's fine. Then Xiao Qi, you can stay here with Ah Ling, and Ruchuan and I will go out and look for it first. If we really can't find it, forget it."

In the huge private room, only He Ling and Wu Qi were left.

Wu Qi looked at her and said, "Most of the dishes are already served, you can eat first."

Several of them are fasting, so it doesn't matter whether they eat or not, but He Ling needs to eat every day.

She picked up her chopsticks, took a bite of the nearest dish, squinted her eyes with satisfaction, and suddenly remembered something.

He Ling took out a jade pendant from his sleeve and handed it to Wu Qi, "Senior Brother Xiao Qi, this is for you."

The original person had taken the Fifth Qi piece of jade pendant before. Now that she has adopted this identity, she should naturally inherit its cause and effect.

What's more, the people at Hunyuan Peak were very kind to her, and she truly regarded them as her senior brothers and sisters.

Fifth Qi took the jade pendant and asked calmly: "Why did you suddenly give me a gift?"
title_en: Chapter 15 Another man from the devil’s path
